name: Berlin street-tree planting standard (09/2024), clearances

source.title: Pflanzung von Straßenbäumen – Standard für Berlin (Stand 09/2024), Abschnitt 5.2 Abstände
source.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt (SenMVKU), Berlin

notes: Three distances (0.5 m carriageway, 0.25 m cycle path, 1.5 m crown to building) were verified against the standard on 2026-09-07. Rules marked assumption=true are editable planning defaults added for this tool and are NOT part of the standard.

rules.label: Trunk to carriageway edge
rules.subject: trunk
rules.quote: Abstand Fahrbahnrand zu Stammmitte mindestens 0,50 m
rules.description: Minimum distance from the carriageway edge to the trunk centre.

rules.label: Trunk to cycle path
rules.subject: trunk
rules.quote: Abstand Radweg zu Stamm möglichst 0,25 m
rules.description: Recommended distance from a cycle path edge to the trunk.

rules.label: Mature crown to building
rules.subject: mature_crown
rules.quote: Abstand ausgewachsene Krone zu mehrgeschossigen Gebäuden möglichst 1,50 m
rules.description: Recommended distance between the edge of the mature crown and multi-storey building fronts. Measured as trunk-to-building distance minus the mature crown radius.

rules.label: Trunk on plantable surface
rules.subject: trunk
rules.description: The trunk must stand on a sidewalk or verge, not on the carriageway or inside a building footprint.

rules.label: Trunk to existing tree
rules.subject: trunk
rules.description: Planning default so new crowns do not grow into existing ones. Editable; not from the standard.

rules.label: Trunk to junction (sight line)
rules.subject: trunk
rules.description: Keeps sight triangles at junctions free. Planning default; the real value depends on the junction design.

rules.label: Remaining sidewalk passage
rules.subject: pit
rules.description: Sidewalk width remaining beside the tree pit. Planning default for barrier-free passage; not from the standard.
